name: luna-pool-orchestrator
description: Adaptive 1/2/4-worker Luna engineering orchestration with shadow routing, task-node telemetry, safe fallbacks, and token-free native status.

interface.shortDescription: Low-cost Luna work with visible Sol governance.
interface.longDescription: Heliolune's compact start_task path deterministically selects one, two, or four Luna/max workers from bounded task signals, while explicit speed-first and token-first profiles remain available. Shadow routing and TASK_NODE_V1 telemetry make decisions auditable. Active workers use renewable liveness leases with no fixed execution cutoff, and idle slots immediately claim queued workstreams. Parallel writes use detached Git worktrees and deterministic safe-apply gates. A shared Luna/high operations leader is used only for liveness or terminal bundles that need compression, while Sol retains planning, architecture, risk, integration review, and final acceptance. A native Windows panel shows token-free live status.
defaultPrompt: Use $luna-pool-orchestrator adaptive start for one bounded task; await once and return compact evidence to Sol.
Use $luna-pool-orchestrator in token-first fallback mode because parallel write isolation is unsafe here.
